_note: How the narrated hero sounds: edit this, then `npm run narrate hero -- --remix` (seconds, no render). levels are dB per track; music is a library track (audio/library/library.json) or synth:pad, ducked under the voice; sfx maps each cue the build emits (move, push, reveal, tap, end) to a generated sound (audio/synth.mjs) and a gain, or null for none. loudness is the whole mix: -16 LUFS for the web, -14 for YouTube.
